symptom: ako/mxcli#1744 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1663): a combo box's custom content could not be written — `combobox cbPerson (…) { optionssourceassociationcustomcontent cc { dynamictext … } }` was refused by check -p with MDL-WIDGET26 "`optionssourceassociationcustomcontent` is not a container of `combobox`, which declares no containers" although `widget describe combobox` listed it as a `widgets` property; the type that switches it on WAS written, so `optionsSourceAssociationCustomContentType: 'yes'` alone passed check and exec and mx check reported CE0642 "Property 'Custom content' is required." at Widgets container 'Custom content' of combo box 'cbPerson'
cause: The built-in combobox.def.json declared no child slots (the content keys were knownProperties). The content belongs to an option-source MODE (widget.xml binds it to that mode's datasource), and only the engine read a mode's childSlots: the unrouted-children rule, MDL-WIDGET26's parentDeclaresSlot, declaredContainers, containerKeyword, `widget describe` and the registry's MDLContainer lower-casing all read def.ChildSlots alone. Nothing tied the …CustomContentType enumeration to its slot
file: sdk/widgets/definitions/combobox.def.json (+ modelsdk copy): mode childSlots with a `switch`; mdl/executor/widget_unrouted_children.go (selectedChildSlots, declaresChildSlots, otherModeSlot, mode-aware MDL-WIDGET30 message), widget_slot_switch.go (slotSwitchProblem = MDL-WIDGET53, switchedSlotsToTurnOn), widget_engine.go (ChildSlotMapping.Switch; explicit pass skips Widgets values), validate_widget_kind.go, validate_widgets.go (childSlotKeyword), widget_registry.go (lowerSlotContainers), cmd_pages_describe_combobox_content.go (comboBoxDescribedMode, comboBoxCustomContent), cmd_pages_describe_output.go, cmd_pages_pluggable_passthrough.go (undescribedContent), widget_describe.go (DescribedContainer.Mode)
insight: **A mode-scoped slot is invisible to every reader of def.ChildSlots** — the engine already built mode slots (selectMappings), so adding them to the definition made the write work and left check refusing it, the container list empty and `widget describe` silent; grep `def.ChildSlots` (and `def.Modes`) when a slot is per mode, and route check and exec through one selectedChildSlots that mirrors selectMappings. **Measure the slot's switch before trusting the slot**: content under the type 'no' (also when the type is left out, since the template stores 'no') is CE0463 on 11.13.0, not a silent hide — one throwaway page per value settled 'yes' 0 errors, 'no' CE0463, the type alone CE0642. The fix is a def-declared `switch` (off/on/caption) that check and exec both read, not a combo box special case. **Describe must print the content only where it re-executes as the same thing**: in the mode exec reselects from the description, and only while the switch is on — a block under 'no' would re-execute as SHOWN content, so it stays in the NOT SHOWN note, and the #1648 refusal narrows to content the parsed description lacks (not a second mode test). **The reference check that changed nothing is the evidence**: `mxcli fix widgets` (mx update-widgets in place) left the written page's BSON identical (10505 ndsl lines, 0 diff). Measured on 11.13.0 with Combo box 2.5.0; the reporter's 2.10.0 was not available here. Not covered: a static-mode combo box's per-value staticDataSourceCustomContent — static values have no MDL spelling yet
